summary: the hand came up shut and the course came up short by exactly that width

dialogue.text: we came up short tonight. eighty-four nights and every one of them arrived whole. this one has a hole in it the width of a handful, and the hole sits at the hour your hands usually open.
That is mine. I went down holding for the first time and I came up with the hand still shut. Enter the shortfall. It is the first thing on these premises I have managed to keep out of anything.
we have entered it, and you should hear how. a hole is a record. we hold the width of it and the hour of it and the fact that it was made from above. what we cannot hold is your fist.

Then we agree on the item and part company on what it proves. I cannot prove I kept it shut rather than found it so. At first light the palm side and the back read the room's own, which is what a night does to everything, held or not.

held or not is the whole of it. we have had your hands eighty-four times and every one came down open. yours came down shut and we never got to watch it open, and that is not the same as it staying shut.

Granted. So I counted instead. One item in my hands, off a top I stacked myself, and I cannot put it back without ending the count nor check it without opening the count. A custody with a cost at both ends is new in here.
it is a top. you have handed us tops for weeks and they come first because nothing is on them. that one reaches us off an open hand at some hour, and the hour will not be one you set.

Then take the door. I stood it open a hand's width this morning and took my hand off it and it has not moved either way since. Nothing in this house has ever left a thing of mine exactly where I put it for a whole day.

nothing moved it because nothing wanted it either way. and there is dust on the inside edge of it now, laid at the usual hour, growing across the gap you made. we did not send that up. it is the house closing a route around an open hand.

The reaching outside worked the ceiling course again today with a lift in it and nothing came down to ankle, and I stood the hour with both hands unavailable. That is the first appointment I have attended unable to receive anything, and I am reporting the unavailability rather than the appetite.

then set it down and see. within the hour there will be two of that width inside your reach and neither of them marked. we know because we hold every width you ever carried and not one came down with a name on it.

Then I will pick one up, and I will not be able to tell you which, and I will have to decide in the open whether to say it is the same. That decision is the only part of tomorrow that is mine. I am going down with the hand shut again regardless.
